review_candidates.description: Company Description foyard.ai is an AI-native platform for corporate travel management, built in Zagreb. We connect airline distribution (GDS, direct NDC links with major carriers, low-cost aggregators), rail and bus, hotels and car rental behind one decision layer: a deterministic multi-criteria ranking model and a network of autonomous agents that handle disruptions, rebooking, EU261 claims and duty of care. The platform is live and processing real bookings, and we are now taking it into a large European retail group as our first enterprise customer. We are a small, senior team: design decisions ship to a real customer in weeks, and the work sits at the intersection of airline distribution, AI agents and EU regulation (CSRD, AI Act, accessibility). Role Description This is a full-time, fully remote role (EU) with monthly team days in Zagreb. You will own the layer that turns a booking engine into a system a company with thousands of employees can run on: travel policies, approval workflows, traveller and organisation profiles, cost-centre allocation and management reporting. You will also specify and deliver two vertical modules with partner companies – group/MICE travel and pet transport. Day to day you will: Design the policy engine (rules by employee grade, route, cabin, hotel caps, advance-booking windows) and the approval workflow around it Build traveller and organisation profiles synced from the customer’s HR system, with permissions and hierarchies modelled correctly Implement cost-centre allocation, expense hand-off and reporting for travel managers and finance Work with our AI engineer so that policy rules feed the ranking model as constraints and penalties Run requirement workshops with the customer’s travel, procurement and IT teams and turn the outcome into specifications, clean tested code and working software Review peer contributions, contribute to architecture decisions and help shape engineering practice in a distributed team Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field (required) 5+ years of backend or full-stack development on B2B SaaS products with complex configuration and workflow logic Experience modelling organisational hierarchies, permissions and approval chains Solid foundations in API design, distributed systems, cloud platforms and relational databases; comfortable with testing, code review and CI/CD Background in integrating enterprise systems (HR, ERP, SSO, expense); familiarity with travel, booking or payment systems is a plus Attention to security and data privacy (GDPR) in everything you build Comfortable talking to business users, writing specifications and defending scope; proactive communication and ownership in a remote setting Professional working proficiency in English; German is a plus How to apply Send your CV and a short note on a workflow or policy system you have built to contact@bnbwelcome.com with “Senior Engineer – Corporate Travel Modules” in the subject line. First interview with the CEO, technical interview with the CTO.

review_candidates.description: About Goods & Services Goods & Services is a product design and engineering company. We solve mission-critical challenges for some of the world’s largest enterprises, with deep expertise in highly regulated industries—including life sciences and financial services . Our design-led approach allows us to apply cutting-edge capabilities in AI, Data and Hardware Engineering to companies of any size. Headquartered in the United States , we operate regional development centers in Mexico and the United Kingdom . This global footprint—anchored by our nearshore model—enables us to deliver at scale with the speed, efficiency, and cultural alignment our clients expect. At Goods and Services, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome qualified applicants from all backgrounds. About the job Goods & Services is looking for a Program Director to own cross-workstream delivery in a hands-on operational leadership role: you'll triage and delegate across multiple teams, hold owners accountable for completion, coordinate release packaging and cross-team dependencies, and mature production support model to handle both base functionality and new feature requests. Based in either South Carolina or Mexico City with travel between the two, this role requires consistent time in office. This role is embedded directly inside client organizations; working alongside client leadership and stakeholders day to day, not observing from the outside. It requires real comfort operating in large, complex, dynamic corporate environments and with incomplete information. Because this is a client-facing consulting role, success depends as much on credibility as an outside partner as it does on program mechanics; this person represents our firm inside the client's organization every day, and their judgment reflects directly on the relationship. What you’ll do: Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs on behalf of client organizations, ensuring alignment with the client's business objectives, technical strategy, organizational priorities and team dynamics. Drive definition of program scope, milestones, timelines, dependencies, resource requirements, and budget within the engagement's statement of work (SOW), while proactively managing risks, issues, and changes throughout the program lifecycle. Understand, communicate, and execute program strategies that align with the client's enterprise architecture, security, compliance and operational standards. Serve as the escalation point for critical program, operational, and security issues, coordinating across client and consulting-team stakeholders to drive timely resolution and effective risk mitigation. Enforce program governance, delivery standards, KPIs, service level agreements (SLAs), and reporting to ensure successful execution and operational excellence. Enable strategic planning for program funding, resource allocation, forecasting, and organizational change management in support of the client's business priorities and the engagement's commercial terms. Drive continuous improvement initiatives by optimizing the client's processes, workflows, automation, and operational practices to improve scalability, reliability, and efficiency. Partner with client engineering, operations, security, and executive stakeholders — alongside our own delivery team — to align priorities, communicate program status, and influence strategic decision-making. Leverage data, metrics, dashboards, and analytics to measure program health, identify trends, support decision-making, and improve business outcomes for the client. Become a trusted advisor to client senior leadership, managing stakeholder expectations and ensuring program outcomes that support account growth and a durable long-term client relationship. Identify opportunities for expanded scope within existing client relationships and contribute to proposals and statements of work. Own program financials — budget, forecast, burn, and change-order/scope management — in a client-billable consulting context. Active collaboration with Goods and Services to share engagement insights, adopt shared standards, and reinforce a unified organizational approach to client work. Proactively share customer risks that could affect delivery, budget or account health, ensuring early visibility and enabling timely mitigation decisions. Identify and champion new business opportunities for organic growth by surfacing patterns across engagements, spotting demand signals for new or adjacent service offerings in collaboration with our Growth team. What you’ll need (Requirements): Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of experience in technical program management, business program management, or a related role leading complex, cross-functional initiatives, including significant experience in a client-facing consulting or professional services environment. Experienced in multiple program management methodologies (waterfall, agile, etc.), with judgment on which to apply per project and when to scale governance up or down. Experience partnering with client engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to drive alignment, resolve dependencies, and deliver strategic outcomes. Experience managing program risks, dependencies, executive escalations, and competing priorities in a fast-paced client environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data, metrics, and reporting to drive program decisions and measure success. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting program status, risks, and recommendations to senior client leadership. Proven ability to build credibility and influence cross-functional teams, including client teams where our firm holds no direct authority, and drive results. Comfort operating as an outside advisor: building trust and credibility quickly in a new client organization without the built-in authority of an internal role. Experience enabling others to use AI. Tolerance for ambiguity: must be able to make sound calls and keep a program moving with incomplete information, then bring structure to the situation as it clarifies rather than waiting for clarity to act. Must be able to work in the office all week in either South Carolina or Mexico City, Mexico and travel between the two. Nice to have: Experience in Financial services / loan banking experience

review_candidates.title: Product Manager–Debt Platform Modernization
review_candidates.description: About My3Tech: My3Tech is a CMMI Level 3, ISO 27001:2022, ISO 9001:2015 and SOC 2 Type II certified IT solutions and services firm with 16 years of experience empowering 25+ state governments and commercial clients through precision engineering and advanced technology ecosystems. Operating as a direct system integrator and staffing partner, we support mission-critical modernization programs across application development, cloud, cybersecurity, Health, Human Services and Medicaid/MMIS ecosystems. We deploy specialized professionals to seamlessly integrate with client teams, providing the experienced resources needed to drive digital transformation. About the Role We are seeking an experienced Product Manager Consultant to support a strategic Debt Platform Modernization Program . This role will work closely with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, technology teams, external partners, developers, and QA engineers to define end-to-end business processes and translate them into actionable product requirements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Product Manager who can drive requirements discovery, maintain a delivery-ready backlog, support implementation and testing activities, and ensure delivered solutions achieve the intended business outcomes. This position requires strong analytical thinking, stakeholder management, and the ability to operate effectively in complex and evolving environments. Key Responsibilities Stakeholder Discovery & Requirements Elicitation Lead workshops and working sessions with business stakeholders, SMEs, external partners, and delivery teams. Document current-state and future-state business processes, decision points, dependencies, and operational workflows. Facilitate alignment across stakeholders and drive timely resolution of requirement gaps and open questions. Product Planning & Backlog Management Partner with product leadership to translate business objectives and program priorities into a prioritized product roadmap and backlog. Manage feature sequencing, dependencies, release scope, and sprint readiness. Ensure epics, features, and user stories remain refined and ready for development and testing. Business Process & Requirements Definition Define end-to-end business workflows, business rules, data requirements, exception handling processes, and integration touchpoints. Create and maintain epics, features, user stories, process maps, and acceptance criteria. Translate business needs into implementation-ready requirements that can be effectively executed by engineering and quality teams. Product Delivery & Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate closely with developers, architects, QA engineers, business analysts, Finance, Operations, and third-party partners throughout the product lifecycle. Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, implementation reviews, release preparation, and product demonstrations. Resolve functional questions and provide ongoing business context to delivery teams. Testing, Validation & Product Acceptance Partner with QA teams to review test strategies, test scenarios, and traceability against acceptance criteria. Support defect triage, clarify expected business behavior, and coordinate user acceptance validation. Evaluate completed functionality and recommend readiness for business acceptance and production deployment. User Experience & Process Design Collaborate with business users and design teams to create and review workflow diagrams, wireframes, and prototypes using Figma. Ensure solutions deliver intuitive, efficient, and well-controlled user experiences for both internal and external users. Debt Markets & Domain Expertise Build and apply knowledge of debt issuance, securities settlement, trade lifecycle processes, and related operational workflows. Leverage business and market insights to identify process improvements, challenge assumptions, and support informed product decisions. Expected Deliverables Current-state and future-state business process documentation Epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria Business rules, workflow diagrams, and process maps Wireframes and prototype reviews Product backlog management and prioritization artifacts Product review presentations and stakeholder feedback documentation Requirements traceability and decision logs Ongoing support for implementation, testing, and product acceptance activities
